payload.text: Armor Industrial Fabricators, Inc CALL: (281) 573-2777 Full-service Fabrication Need something cut, bent, sheared, drilled, or welded? Look no further. With in-house machining, sandblast and paint, load testing and even urethane mold pouring, we have the equipment and experience to get your job done. Learn more... Contact Us Precision Machining When it comes to turning, boring, milling, drilling and tapping - whether you have one part or thousands, our machining department is up to the challenge. Learn more... Contact Us Follow Us ABOUT US Knowledgeable, Experienced With decades of experience in fabrication and machining, there is not much that Armor's management team has not seen. Put our expertise to work for you to get your projects done right. Convenient Location Armor's 20,000 square foot manufacturing facility sits along Interstate 10, just east of Houston, TX. This location provides unobstructed access to Houston highways and shipping ports. Industries Served Manufacturers Chemical Plants / Refineries Oil & Gas Offshore / Subsea Instrumentation And more... Certified Welders Qualified Procedures Precision Machining Quality Control Fabrication Full-service Fabrication If it's metal or plastic, we can make it. Our staff is equipped to take on nearly any project including structural steel, piping, guardrail, storage racks, fixtures, shims, and much more. Contact us today for quotes or more information. Fabrication Gallery Equipment Welders - Stick, MIG, TIG Waterjet Plasma Punch Shear Press Brake Band Saw Drill Press Procedures We maintain weld procedures for multiple AWS and ASME specifications, with several procedures going through additional DNV certification. Our staff will work with you to ensure that all procedures meet your specifications. machining Precision Machining For projects large or small, easy or complicated - our team is prepared. We have experience working with a wide range of materials, anything from Teflon and Acrylic to Super Duplex Stainless Steel and Nickel alloys.
